{{Top|leg|title=''Cutlass''-class corvette}}
{{Otheruses|Cutlass}}
The '''''Cutlass''-class corvette''' was a [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] type used by the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> The [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] used it as a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] during the years following the [[Swarm War]].<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref><ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|156|''Cutlass''-class corvette}}</ref> In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], at least one ship of this class appeared among the [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] forces supporting the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] during the [[Blockade of Corellia]].<ref name="Bloodlines" />
